name: state-audit
description: After each Edit or Write of UI code, runs the implicit-state-audit skill's scan.js (no model) and shows the model only the hidden-state findings: boolean flags that allow impossible states, scattered DOM state, timer-sequenced state. Optional second reviewer (Gemini, then local Ollama) only when the project sets one in .claude/state-audit.json, and only for a file the scan flagged. Adds nothing when the file is clean. Never blocks; fails open. Reads no env.
